column1: #   ticker_file              path to file with one ticker per line (alt to ticker)
#   start_year               first year to include in scan
#   end_year                 last year (leave empty = up to today)
#   entry_months             months to scan for entry dates
#                            leave empty to scan all 12 months
#   min_days_in_trade        minimum window length in calendar days (default 5)
#   max_days_in_trade        maximum window length in calendar days (default 45)
#   stop_pct                 Max Adverse Excursion % filter — e.g. 9.0 (default 9.0)
#   profit_factor_threshold  minimum profit factor / F/L ratio (default 1.5)
#   max_consec_losses        max consecutive losing years allowed (default 999 = off)
#   top_n                    number of trades shown in chart (default 20)
#   output_path              output directory for CSV + PNG
